sources.title: Blockly Games: Movie
sources.evidence: The source presents circle, rectangle, and line drawing blocks, a time block ranging across an animation, arithmetic expressions for changing coordinates, a play preview, and frame-by-frame reconstruction of a target movie.

transformation: The benchmark uses an original procedural studio with a visible reference window, generated geometric layers, expression blocks, a full-loop preview, and independent replay grading. It does not copy Blockly's interface, levels, art, code, or page implementation.
runtime_assets: All geometry, colors, block labels, and reference frames are generated locally. No third-party image, font, or game runtime asset is loaded.
